name: Kempton Steam Museum, Kempton Park
summary: See one of the world's largest working triple-expansion steam engines in the historic waterworks at Kempton. Selected steaming weekends bring the machinery dramatically to life, with additional static opening dates during the year.
reasonToVisit: One of the world's largest working triple-expansion steam engines, in a historic waterworks
planningDetail: A date-led attraction — choose a steaming or static opening day before travelling
